---
title: "Cloud Native Geospatial (CNG) Onboarding Tutorials"
---

This site includes a collection of tutorials that are designed to help you get started with Cloud Native Geospatial (CNG) technologies. The tutorials are Jupyter Notebooks, stored on GitHub

# Viewing the Tutorials

To view a tutorial, select a page from the left sidebar.

# Executing Code in the Tutorials

The Jupyter Notebook tutorials can be run locally or in the cloud.
